answer_1.quote: Experiment results on long-form QA and open-ended text completion show that QUOTE-TUNING significantly increases quoting by up to 130% relative to base models while maintaining or improving downstream performance.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form answers to questions and open-ended text completions.

answer_2.quote: We report the BARTScore and Rouge-L between generated and reference answers as metrics for adequacy of generated answers. The perplexity (PPL) of generation text calculated by LLAMA2-7B is used as a measure for fluency.

answer_3.quote: We follow the standard evaluation procedure on TruthfulQA, which fine-tunes GPT-3 on human annotations as truthfulness and informativeness judges.
methods: Fine-tuned GPT-3 as judge for truthfulness and informativeness
